title: PostgreSQL Vacuum Wraparound — Transaction ID exhaustion
root_cause: PostgreSQL uses 32-bit transaction IDs. Without regular VACUUM, the ID space wraps around and the database shuts down to prevent data loss. autovacuum_freeze_max_age default (200M) may be too high for write-heavy workloads.
resolution_type: Invariant: oldest_unfrozen_xid < current_xid - safety_margin. Monitoring alert when age > 150M.
